status_note: Rejected at Roc's gate 2026-08-05. Kept on record, not deleted. The Baker's approved set is `portion` and `weigh`.
learn_source: Watch the baker turn a feast-sized trough at the counter in the Town scene — a communal feast asks for more hands than any one baker has
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a workable mass once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the whole mass is worked through in one cast; at baseline the middle needs a second pass. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: shaggy and just-mixed, the whole trough is worked smooth and elastic as if by many hands; already fully worked, it goes over — tight, tough, and slow to rise
Churned through — the cream breaks and comes together as butter
Wedged even, the trapped air pressed out
no_effect — nothing in it yields to working
No physical effect — no working attaches to a living body
receivers.reaction_kind: startles at the stirred air where the cast landed, hops down and resettles
sizes it up as spare hands — starts naming whose batch is furthest behind
